subject: Consolidating Portal Profiles: canonical evidence index + SSO terraform handoff
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@vendr.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Portal Ops <portal-ops@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: canonical profile + SSO metadata for Acme Health onboarding

Hi Lauren,

Quick ask from Acme's procurement/security team: they want us to consolidate the existing Vendr and OneTrust portal profiles for Redwood into a single canonical profile we can point to in their SIG/CAIQ review.

What they need from us:
- a single evidence index CSV (mapping to SIG/CAIQ questions) that reviewers can scan
- SSO metadata and an example Terraform module they can use to provision the SAML app in their IdP (Okta)
- a short mapping doc that shows which answers live in Vendr vs OneTrust and where auditors should look

Can you own producing the index and a minimal terraform snippet? Acme would like to begin their review week of Apr 19.

Attachments from our side: none yet.

Thanks,
Alicia
Vendor Enablement Manager, Vendr

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: k arthik_iyer@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, Alicia Gomez <agomez@vendr.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: canonical profile + SSO metadata for Acme Health onboarding

Thanks for the heads up, Alicia — looping in infra and security to run a brief sprint for this one.

Plan proposal (owners & deliverables):
1) Canonical evidence index (owner: Mina) — single CSV with columns: portal, question_id, answer, supporting_attachment, link, last_updated. Target draft: Apr 14 EOD.
2) Portal mapping doc (owner: Marcus) — short README showing which portal holds golden source and how to navigate. Target draft: Apr 14 EOD.
3) SSO Terraform snippet + metadata (owner: Karthik) — minimal module to create the SAML app in Okta + example vars for Acme. Target draft: Apr 13 EOD.
4) Upload + review pass (owner: Lauren) — stitch the three artifacts into a single Deliverable folder on Drive and share with Vendr & Acme. Target: Apr 15.

Constraints / notes:
- Mina, please make the CSV map to SIG and CAIQ question IDs where possible; include a short confidence tag (gold/silver/bronze) per row.
- Karthik, we should avoid embedding secrets; provide only PKI/SP metadata and an example TF resource that references variables for IDs/credentials.
- Marcus, include a short section on evidence rotation cadence and who to ping for stale docs.

Alicia — does Acme need us to upload to both Vendr and OneTrust, or will they accept the Drive link + Vendr profile?

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Security Programs Lead
Redwood Inference

From: k arthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com; Alicia Gomez <agomez@vendr.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: canonical profile + SSO metadata for Acme Health onboarding

Looping in a couple of implementation notes from infra:
- We should deliver an example Terraform module that creates an Okta SAML App with minimal scopes. I attached a small snippet and a README with required variables. Avoid automated user provisioning in the snippet — Acme does that on their side.
- For metadata: provide the SP entityID, ACS URL, and certificate fingerprint only. No private keys.
- On timelines: Apr 13 draft for TF is tight but doable if we keep the module example minimal.

Attachments (drafts):
- sso-terraform-acme.tf (snippet, 3 resources: okta_app_saml, okta_app_saml_signon, okta_app_group_assignment)
- portal-mapping.md (mapping outlines: Vendr=answers/attachments; OneTrust=full evidence PDF store)

Short checklist for Mina when building the CSV:
- include SIG/CAIQ IDs in a column called "canonical_id"
- put direct downloadable links where possible (Vendr/OneTrust) and a Drive fallback
- add last_updated and owner columns

-Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@vendr.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Portal Ops <portal-ops@acmehealth.com>, k arthik_iyer@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-13T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: canonical profile + SSO metadata for Acme Health onboarding

Perfect — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. A few follow-ups from Acme:
- They prefer we upload the canonical index and the mapping doc into Vendr and provide a Drive link for OneTrust (their internal auditors will pull from Drive).
- Small change request on the TF snippet: Acme's Okta org requires the certificate to be in PEM format and prefers ACS URL to be parameterized as var.acs_url. Can you make those two small edits in the final?
- Target cutover for their review: Apr 20 (they will start the SIG pass).

We'll wait for your Drive folder link and the Vendr upload confirmation. If you want, Vendr can create the Vendr evidence placeholder and ping their reviewers once the upload is done.

Thanks again — looking forward to the drafts.

Best,
Alicia
Vendor Enablement Manager, Vendr
